exposure: Hysteroscopic treatment of retained products of conception (RPOC)
cohort: 84 women who underwent hysteroscopic treatment for RPOC and had a follow-up hysteroscopy
finding: Women who developed RPOC after cesarean section were at significantly higher risk of developing IUAs after hysteroscopic treatment compared to women who had a vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: Women with RPOC after cesarean section had a higher risk of developing IUAs after hysteroscopic treatment (50.5% vs 14.3% after vaginal delivery).
